description: Receipt-to-public-log inclusion composer (build1-completeness-witnessing, INC1). One synoi.inclusion.v1 bundle per receipt stitches LEG 1 (local RFC 6962 audit path over receipt OIDs, folding to completeness root R) to LEG 2 (a Rekor inclusion proof over R). This vector freezes the surface INC1 OWNS and that any reimplementation must reproduce: (a) the leaf preimage is leafHash(utf8(oid_hex_64)), ADR_023 D1 FORK-B, identical to the completeness-spine vector; (b) the local audit path folds to R via RFC 6962; (c) the load-bearing JOIN local.root_sha256 === witness.root_sha256_hex, so a valid external proof for a DIFFERENT root can NEVER certify a receipt in R (the false-AUTHORIZE trap); (d) when the window root is not yet witnessed the composer yields a typed not-yet-witnessed state, never a false verified. LEG 2's RFC 6962 inclusion + C2SP checkpoint signature verification is frozen separately by vectors/witness (rekor-verify); this vector deliberately does not re-embed a p256 checkpoint. All hashes are bare lowercase hex, no sha256: prefix.

constants.leaf_preimage: leafHash(oid_hex) = SHA-256(0x00 || utf8(oid_hex_64)); hashes the hex STRING, NOT the raw 32 digest bytes (ADR_023 D1 / FORK-B)
constants.fold_rule: current = leaf; for step in audit_path (bottom-up): current = position=='L' ? internalHash(step.sibling, current) : internalHash(current, step.sibling). Bundle is local-valid iff current == root_sha256.
constants.join_rule: local.root_sha256 (lowercased) MUST equal witness_root (lowercased). A mismatch is status 'root-mismatch' and verified:false, never 'verified'.

cases.name: good_composed_index1
cases.note: A well-formed bundle for the middle receipt of a 3-leaf population in Journal order. The local audit path folds to R and witness_root === R. LEG 1 and the JOIN both pass; LEG 2 (the Rekor proof over R) is proven by the rekor-verify vector. verified:true is reached only when leg 2 also verifies, so the terminal status here is the join-passing precondition, not a standalone 'verified'.

cases.name: good_composed_index0
cases.note: The first receipt of the same 3-leaf population. Its audit path (two right-siblings) differs from index 1, proving position matters.

cases.name: good_composed_single_leaf
cases.note: Single-receipt population: the audit path is empty and the fold reduces to leaf === R.

cases.name: tampered_local_flipped_sibling
cases.note: The first sibling in the index-1 audit path has its leading nibble flipped (1 -> 9). The fold no longer reaches R, so the bundle is local-invalid regardless of the witness half.

cases.name: join_root_mismatch_false_authorize
cases.note: The false-AUTHORIZE trap. The local audit path is honest and folds to R, but the witness half attests a DIFFERENT root R' (all-b). A verifier MUST return root-mismatch and never verified, even if that witness proof would independently verify on R'. This is the single most important INC1 invariant.

cases.name: not_yet_witnessed
cases.note: The window root has no external witness proof yet (witness_root is null). The local half is fully derivable, but the composer yields a typed not-yet-witnessed state carrying R, never a false verified.

cases.name: d1_raw_byte_preimage_would_not_fold
cases.note: ADR_023 D1 lock. If a reimplementation hashes the raw 32 OID bytes (leafHash(hexToBytes(oid))) instead of the utf-8 hex string, the leaf differs and the SAME honest audit path no longer folds to R. The conformant leaf is the string preimage; the raw-byte leaf is a control that MUST NOT fold.

d1_control.note: Fold the raw-byte leaf against the pinned string-tree audit_path. It MUST NOT reach root_sha256.
